verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 Gateway REST API spec covering model endpoints under /v1/accounts, and its API reference says the REST API lets you automate management of models. That points to programmatic model listing. However, no evidence explicitly shows a GET /v1/models-style endpoint that enumerates the live public serverless catalog, and the 'OpenAI-compatible' claim does not by itself show that a models-list route exists. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented list-models endpoint and its response schema, confirmation that it returns the full live catalog rather than only account-owned models, and hands-on corroboration.
